name: voice-draft
headline: Draft your week by talking
sub: Up to 60 seconds of speech becomes a lineup, each task priced 10 to 50 points.

name: roster
headline: Your whole week on one screen
sub: Five starter slots plus flex, with Submit Proof on the Up Next row.

name: verdict
headline: An AI referee judges your photo
sub: The referee stamps VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED and writes its reason under the photo.

name: feed
headline: Your league sees every verified proof
sub: Another member can challenge a proof within 24 hours, and the league votes.

name: league
headline: Everyone plays for the same pot
sub: Clear all five slots to keep your stake; finishers split forfeited stakes, less 10%.

name: wrapped
headline: Every week ends with a recap
sub: Five cards cover the champion, best proof, biggest comeback, fastest quick-time and your week.
